heading: INT. HOPE VALLEY FERTILITY CLINIC - WAITING ROOM - MORNING

units.text: INT. HOPE VALLEY FERTILITY CLINIC - WAITING ROOM - MORNING
We see a bright, quiet waiting room.
A fish tank bubbling in the corner.
A rack of old magazines no one has touched.
Sunlight comes through the blinds in thin stripes.
BETH, 30s, nervous, in a yellow cardigan, sits on the edge of a chair, twisting a tissue.
Next to her is CAL, 30s, tall, dressed too neatly, holding a folder of forms.

units.name: CAL
paren: smiling too hard, patting her knee

units.text: You said that about the camping trip.
units.name: BETH

units.text: Okay, that was a different kind of great.
units.name: CAL

units.text: A little orange fish swims in a circle.
Beth watches it as if it knows something.
Beth and Cal Whitaker, Dr. Okafor will see you now. Room three, please.
units.name: INTERCOM

units.text: Oh gosh. That's us. That's definitely us.
units.name: BETH
CAL
paren: picking it up, handing it back
